name: Lost But Not Forgotten
summary: Misha Tor'kren waits at her homestead for news of her son, Kron. He went west to hunt crocolisks along the Southfury River, and she fears the worst.

sections.title: A Mother's Dread
sections.body: Misha Tor'kren lives at a farmstead northwest of Razor Hill in Durotar. Days ago, her son Kron set out west toward the Southfury River, along the Barrens border, to hunt its fierce crocolisks. Misha warned him how deadly the beasts were, but pride drove him to leave and prove his strength. No one has seen him since.

sections.title: A Grim Confirmation
sections.body: Misha asks you to search the Southfury River's banks for any sign of Kron, even inside the crocolisks. The Dreadmaw crocolisks hold the answer: among their remains, you find Kron's swallowed amulet. When you bring it back, Misha knows her son did not survive. The keepsake gives her the closure she needs to begin mourning.

aliases: who gives lost but not forgotten
faq.answer: Misha Tor'kren is an orc mother who lives at a homestead northwest of Razor Hill in Durotar. She fears for her missing son, Kron, and asks travelers to look for any sign of him.
Kron was Misha Tor'kren's headstrong son. He went to hunt dangerous crocolisks near the Southfury River, hoping to prove his strength, and died there.
Kron went west across Durotar toward the Barrens border, to hunt along the banks of the Southfury River.

faq.q: How do you prove Kron's fate to Misha?
faq.answer: You find Kron's swallowed amulet among the remains of Dreadmaw crocolisks in the Southfury River. Bringing it to Misha confirms that he died.

Misha gives you a gift she had prepared for Kron's triumphant return from the hunt. After learning of his death, she cannot bear to look at it and gives it to you, the traveler who brought her closure.

faq.q: Why did Kron leave in the first place?
faq.answer: Kron left out of pride and a desire to prove his skill as a hunter. When Misha warned him about the dangerous crocolisks, he grew angry and stormed off to hunt them anyway.

angles.text: As an orc, you know pride and martial glory matter deeply in your culture. Kron's fate shows the cost of facing dangerous beasts without respect for their strength.
As a hunter, you know a tracker must judge the prey's ferocity. Kron failed to do so, and the crocolisks killed him.
As a member of the Horde, you know life in Durotar is harsh. Families struggle against the unforgiving land and the deadly predators along its borders.
